findings.detail: no X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options or Referrer-Policy on the marketing homepage and /pricing; 3 headers absent across all 40 sampled pages
no Content-Security-Policy on www or the /checkout-receipt path; 12 sampled responses fall back to an implicit default-src wildcard
certificate for www.acme-corp.com valid until 2026-10-08 (11 days); Let's Encrypt auto-renewal confirmed in the deployment task log
TLS 1.2 with ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM on the edge; TLS 1.3 offered but legacy DHE suites 0x009D/0x009E still enabled
no Strict-Transport-Security on www or m; the mobile homepage is served over plaintext on the app user-agent path
reflected search term on /support?q= is echoed unescaped inside the <title> tag in 4 of 20 probes
POST /api/v1/transactions/search with order=id;select pg_sleep(4) returned in 4.2s vs a 0.1s baseline on 3 of 5 runs — time-based blind SQLi in the merchant search endpoint
500 on /api/v1/payouts returns a raw stack with the SQLAlchemy query string and table names (transaction_accounts, payouts_ledger)
GET /api/v1/session/continue?next=//thirdparty-01.example reflects the next value unchanged in the 302 Location header
POST /api/v1/checkout/token accepted 1,000 requests in 60s from a single IP with no 429 — no rate limiting on the card tokenization endpoint
deprecated /api/v1/merchants still live; the version header exposes the internal build tag of the current deployment
GET /graphql?query={__schema{types{name}}} returns the full introspection schema — 14 mutation types incl. approvePayout, adjustLimits and impersonateMerchant on the production admin API
/.env on the admin origin returns 200 with DATABASE_URL=postgres://svc-pay@postgres.acme-corp.com:5432/acme_prod and a live card-provider secret key (14 variables total)
admin portal accepts 6-character passwords; 11 of 40 audit accounts accepted abc123 as their new password during the test window
admin.acme-corp.com exposes 8443 (self-signed console) and 6379 to the public internet; 6379 answers PING to an anonymous connection
login endpoint returned 200 after 300 password guesses in 5 minutes; no lockout, captcha or exponential backoff on the admin form
POST /checkout/session/{id}/confirm carries no CSRF token; a cross-site form POST was accepted on 5 of 5 live sessions
SPA catch-all serves index.html for /api/* — requests to /api/v1/merchants/99999 returned 200 HTML instead of 404, masking routing and auth failures
no CSP on the checkout iframe host; the card widget is injected via <script> from a third-party wallet vendor with no integrity attribute
3DS redirect builds the callback URL with card data in the query string (?pan=411111...&cvv=123) — PAN and CVV land in browser history and the web server access log
HTTPS /checkout returns a 307 to http://checkout.acme-corp.com/verify on the payment-capture path — a session downgrade on a PCI surface
no X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors on /checkout; the page renders correctly inside a cross-origin iframe
webhook event 61c2a1 (charge.succeeded, $2,450.00) replayed verbatim 3 hours later with the same signature and was processed twice — no idempotency check on replay
the tokenization proxy writes the full PAN 411111...1111 to stdout on debug; 214 PAN-bearing log lines captured in one 10-minute run
a checkout token issued for a $120 charge was accepted again for $120 the same day — the token is not single-use within the 24h window
GET /api/v1/merchants/{id}/payouts enumerates merchant payouts by numeric id with no ownership check; 20 consecutive ids returned 200 with ledger amounts
POST /api/v1/transfer is reachable with a standard user session; the admin-scope check is bypassed by omitting the X-Api-Role header on 3 endpoints
POST /webhooks/payment accepts JSON with no signature header; 12 of 15 replay attempts without an HMAC were accepted and logged as processed
GET /webhooks/payment returns 200 with the last 5 webhook payloads (amounts, merchant ids) to anonymous callers
no Idempotency-Key handling; duplicate delivery of the same event id creates duplicate ledger entries
status.acme-corp.com CNAMEs to a status-page vendor the company stopped paying in March; the page now serves a parked vendor landing page — a takeover surface
GET /healthz returns full component versions (nginx 1.24.0, node 20.11.1, redis 7.2) to anonymous callers
GET /backups/ returns an autoindex of 214 .sql.gz files (one per nightly job) with no index page configured
GET /backups/acme_prod_20260926.sql.gz returns 200 (26MB); schema and sample rows include customer PII column names
nginx 1.24.0 with the HTTP/2 CVE-2023-44487 — current is 1.27.x; the Server header exposes the exact version
5432 open to the internet; pg_hba allows any source for user svc-pay
postgres superuser password is a single 8-character word found in the 2023 credential dumps (reused)
6379 answers an anonymous CONFIG GET on 3 of 3 connections — no auth configured
the session cache holds checkout tokens in plaintext and is readable without a password
no DNSSEC on the apex; resolvers return RRSIG-less responses and the DS record is absent from the parent zone
SPF record v=spf1 include:thirdparty-01.example ~all lets an unauthenticated relay pass the envelope; DMARC is p=none
no DMARC policy; the single TXT record found is p=none, so spoofed billing mail is not rejected
no DKIM selector published; transactional billing email is sent unsigned
chain valid for 26 days; the intermediate is a shared Let's Encrypt R3
nginx 1.24.0 with the HTTP/2 CVE-2023-44487 across 14 edge nodes; 6 nodes still unpatched
sshd on the jump host still allows the arcfour cipher and a none MAC
session cookie acme_sid lacks Secure and SameSite; set over https but readable on the http downgrade path
sandbox login form posts plaintext credentials over http; the redirect chain drops the https hop
admin console reachable from the public internet with no VPN or WAF layer and no geo-block
Grafana anonymous access enabled; the payouts dashboard exposes merchant volume and refund counts to unauthenticated viewers
no HSTS on the mobile user-agent path; the preload list has no entry for the apex
artifact bucket autoindexes 40k files including signed mobile app builds
a live card-provider key appears as a literal in src/client.ts; 12 secrets in the public payments SDK repo, 9 still usable against sandbox
git log --all -S DATABASE_URL returns 14 commits; .env.example in commit 3f2a91 still contains a key-rotation remnant
npm audit flags 23 vulnerabilities (7 high) including an RCE in a lodash dependency pinned transitively
repo README documents a 6-character default admin password and a password reset that never expires
test fixtures embed PAN patterns (411111...); CI logs echo the fixtures on every failed run
no SBOM or provenance in the release pipeline; the dependency lockfile is unsigned
